Name: Movement bonus
Description: Set the current ship's raw movement bonus. Zero gives the normal factor. Positive values raise lateral speed and acceleration; negative values use the loaded handling scale. Bank-angle smoothing also changes.
RestoreBehavior: Applied once to the current ship. Native loadout rebuilding or ship replacement may overwrite it. Disconnecting does not undo the change; profiles cannot replay it.

Evidence.Finding: Native int delta adder changes state+36. Its consumer clamps the resulting movement factor to0.1..3; negative raw values are multiplied by systemparam0+16 first.
Evidence.Level: Complete native IDA assembly, resource and lifecycle checks, and isolated fake-memory/callout tests. No live Gummi validation.

Name: Roll impulse bonus
Description: Set the current ship's raw roll impulse bonus. Zero gives factor1; -100 gives0; 200 gives3. This changes the roll impulse, while normal roll timing and invulnerability remain active.
RestoreBehavior: Applied once to the current ship. Native loadout rebuilding or ship replacement may overwrite it. Disconnecting does not undo the change; profiles cannot replay it.

Evidence.Finding: Native int delta adder changes state+40. Getter returns clamp(1+bonus/100,0,3), consumed by native roll movement.
Evidence.Level: Complete native IDA assembly, resource and lifecycle checks, and isolated fake-memory/callout tests. No live Gummi validation.

Name: Lock-on bonus
Description: Set the current ship's lock-on bonus. Higher values reduce future target-acquisition delays, subject to each category's native minimum. Already-running timers are not restarted.
RestoreBehavior: Applied once to the current ship. Native loadout rebuilding or ship replacement may overwrite it. Disconnecting does not undo the change; profiles cannot replay it.

Evidence.Finding: Native delta adder changes state+44; future timer reloads use max(row+16,row+8-bonus*row+12) for enabled categories.
Evidence.Level: Complete native IDA assembly, resource and lifecycle checks, and isolated fake-memory/callout tests. No live Gummi validation.
